verdict.rationale: Cline documents headless runs inside GitHub Actions and other pipelines, and it shows reviewing piped diffs (`git diff | cline "review these changes"`). That makes a CI-driven PR review plausible with the product's own capabilities. There is no dedicated PR-review feature: the documented scheduling is cron-based, which is a recurring schedule rather than a trigger on each pull request, and nothing shows feedback being posted back to the PR. Missing for 10: a documented per-PR trigger, PR comment/inline feedback output, a first-party GitHub/GitLab review integration, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic code review with contextual feedback on every pull request
